# Simon Fraser University

> > Simon Fraser University is a comprehensive research institution with three campuses across British Columbia offering undergraduate and graduate programs, student services, and community engagement.

SFU serves students, alumni, employers, and the public through integrated portals and campus hubs in Burnaby, Vancouver, and Surrey. The university provides admissions support, financial giving opportunities, career resources, and institutional information across all stakeholder groups.

## Key Topics

- Simon Fraser University (SFU)
- Burnaby Campus
- Surrey Campus
- Vancouver Campus
- Admissions
- Undergraduate Programs
- Graduate Programs

- British Columbia

## Main Portals & Entry Points

- [Simon Fraser University Homepage](https://www.sfu.ca): SFU homepage with campus tours, admissions info for undergrad/grad programs
- [Students Portal](https://www.sfu.ca/main/dashboard/students.html): Student portal with resources, admissions, campus services and support
- [Alumni Portal](https://www.sfu.ca/main/dashboard/alumni.html): Alumni hub with community engagement, benefits, stories and events
- [Parents & Public Portal](https://www.sfu.ca/main/dashboard/parents-public.html): Portal for parents and public with admission and family service information

## Campuses

- [Burnaby Campus](https://www.sfu.ca/campuses/burnaby.html): Burnaby campus overview with location, facilities and campus information
- [Surrey Campus](https://www.sfu.ca/campuses/surrey.html): Surrey campus details with programs, admissions, services and support
- [Vancouver Campus](https://www.sfu.ca/campuses/vancouver.html): Vancouver campus information and university overview

## Engagement & Partnerships

- [SFU Advancement - Giving](https://give.sfu.ca): Donation platform for scholarships, endowments, and university fundraising
- [Employers](https://www.sfu.ca/main/dashboard/employers.html): Employer resources for recruitment, hiring and university partnerships
- [Join SFU - Careers](https://www.sfu.ca/main/dashboard/careers.html): SFU career opportunities, job postings, hiring across Burnaby, Vancouver, Surrey

## Institutional Information

- [Media Portal](https://www.sfu.ca/main/dashboard/media.html): Media portal for press resources and university institutional information
